notes.title: Update V.0.2.3
notes.notes:
• When structures are built, the grass details on the surface are removed and the surface textures are changed.
• Villagers' interaction with structures has been improved.
• Villagers animation problems have been improved.
• The character's arrow shooting system has been improved.
• Fixed world interaction issues when interacting with the UI.
• Improved environmental interactions when canceling or demolishing buildings.
• Archers' attacks have been improved.
• Improved wall building.
• Fixed a bug that occurred while recording.
• New soldiers who joined the army were directed to where the flag was.

notes.title: UI Update
notes.notes:
Update

- UI design has been reworked. Everything that is 2D has been completely changed.


Bug & Fix

-Multiple building selection bug fixed.
-Villagers not changing missions fixed.
-Fixed errors that occurred as a result of removing the building while the villager was constructing the building.
-Fixed the problem of being able to get hold of pressing the 'C' key while placing a mine building.
-Technology panel movement has been changed.

notes.title: Patch V.0.2.1
notes.notes:
- Technology points can now be reset. Added reset button to tech tree. You can give points again by resetting your technology points.
- Fixed the tree not spawning issue.
- Fixed scale distortion that occurred when spawning trees.
- Added button to UI to see tech tree.
- Improved the arrow shooting system.
- The technology system has been balanced.
- Ai improvement has been made.
- Improvements were made to the lod system of the soldiers.
- A button has been added to remove the employees in the research building from the building.
- Fixed problems with archer and hunter.
- The movement system in the notification system has been improved.
- Increased the archer's strike speed.
- Fixed the issue where the arrow stuck to the enemy.
- Improved the main character's arrow shooting system.
- Added effect to arrows.

notes.title: Tech Tree Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we have introduced the tech tree system for UNIONATIC and made some minor updates. You can see the details of the update below. You can make your comments about the update on our discord server (https://discord.gg/MannWJFZ6C) or via steam. Your comments are very valuable to us, we are waiting for everyone.

The technology system was introduced.

The level system has been brought to all buildings and the main character. Upgrades can now be made, such as the yield of buildings, the number of people, the health levels of the workers in the buildings, and the health of the buildings.

New building

-Research building has been brought.
- Villagers entering the research building will collect research points, and with the collected points, the levels of the building and character from the tech tree can be improved.

Minor fixes

-Fixing bug fixed.
-Performance has been improved.
-UI updated.
-AI has been improved.
-Enemies have been updated.
-Arrow throwing system has been improved.
